app-templates.message:
refactor: no compatibility paths; the schemas refer to each other

## Intent

Nothing of the runtime is published, so no old path needs to stay alive. The quiz's schema should not carry a copy of the question definitions.

## Key changes

- The quiz's re-exports of the questions and the package exports quiz/question and */messages/*.json are gone; the questions are imported from runtime/shared/questions.
- The quiz's schema refers to the question schema, as the explainer's does. The sync script and its test are gone.
- The schemas have urn ids (urn:lernapps:schema:<name>.v1) instead of the address of a site that does not exist. Error messages name the schema file in the app's node_modules; the READMEs link the files in the repo.
- The question tests are renamed and import the shared questions.

app-templates.reason: Kept apart: own smell (styles of the questions).
app-templates.message:
refactor: the questions have their own stylesheet and class names

## Intent

A question is not the quiz's, yet it rendered quiz-* classes, and the explainer restyled them in about 25 rules of its own.

## Key changes

- The question markup uses question, question-option, question-feedback and so on.
- Its look is in runtime/shared/questions/questions.css, which the quiz and the explainer import. They set its colours as --question-* custom properties.
- The quiz's stylesheet keeps only its page: languages, start form, progress, result, solutions and celebration.
- The explainer's "Neue Aufgabe" button of a generated exercise has a class of its own.
- Screenshots before and after (quiz and explainer, desktop and 360 px) are pixel-identical.

refactor: one table of the languages and their locales

## Intent

The languages were listed four times, with three tables of locales and different fallbacks. Adding a language must be complete or not at all.

## Key changes

- shared/languages.ts holds LANGUAGES, Language, localeOf and textsIn.
- The registries of the runtime's own texts (questions, quiz, explainer, interactive) are typed by it, and the validators take their list of languages from it.

refactor: the large modules of the explainer split along their seams

## Intent

Three explainer modules of 800 to 1100 lines each mixed several concerns, which makes them hard to read and change.

## Key changes

- load.ts becomes the site's check, schema.ts (validators and the explainer's words for schema errors) and check-page.ts (what the schema cannot say about a page).
- generated.ts becomes generated/: types, comparator, values, texts, question and soundness, each importing only what comes before it.
- components.ts becomes components/: read, props and exercise. The checks of a component's code are shared and generic.
- The architecture test also fails on a cycle of imports in the runtime. It found one between render.ts and tutor.ts; the shared type now lives in content.ts.
- The architecture documents name the new paths; the component rules are a building block of the shared runtime.
